title: Scalar-compatible truncations and bounded standard structure at common stages
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, $\ell$ a prime invertible in $k$, and $X$ a separated finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Fix an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ and finite intermediate fields $E\subset L$ over $\mathbf Q_\ell$. Write $A_E=\mathcal O_E$, choose a uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and put $B_{E,X}=\varprojlim_{n\ge1}(A_E/\varpi_E^n)_X$ and $E_X=B_{E,X}[1/\varpi_E]$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. These are the continuous completed coefficient sheaves on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use the derived-complete constructible integral categories with compatible etale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], their raw rationalizations $D^b_c(X,E)$ [def-weil-pbc-rational-category], their bounded localized standard t-structures [prop-weil-localized-tstructure], and the pair category $D^b_c(X,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$ [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category], with the finite scalar functors $T_{L/E}$ and associators of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension].

Every $T_{L/E}$ is t-exact [def-weil-t-structure]. Its canonical comparisons with $\tau^{\le r}$, $\tau^{\ge r}$ and degree-zero cohomology $\mathcal H^r$ [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves] are natural and satisfy the identity and composition equations with the specified scalar associators. On the pair category there is a bounded t-structure whose two halves and heart are the isomorphism closures of pairs $(E,K)$ with $K$ in the respective finite-stage half or heart. Truncation functors and their maps are induced by $(E,K)\mapsto(E,\tau_EK)$ and by conjugating finite-stage truncations of arrows by these canonical comparisons. These formulas are independent of representatives and descend all truncation-map equations and distinguished truncation triangles. In particular $\mathcal H^r(E,K)\cong(E,\mathcal H^r_EK)$, and every object in the common-stage heart becomes isomorphic to a degree-zero cohomology object at one finite enlargement of its coefficient field.

source.place: Propositions 6.8.11(3) and 6.8.14; finite free scalar extension, coherent common-stage truncations and t-structure axioms

proof.text: Apply [lem-cbc-compactification-geometry-fibre-bound] to $X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$: $X$ is Noetherian, finite-dimensional, with $\ell$ invertible. For $R=B_{E,X}$ and $S=B_{L,X}$, [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison] identifies completed extension with $K\otimes_R^LS$ and makes $S$ finite free. By [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], a K-flat model from [lem-pc-kflat-resolution] computes this tensor; a basis identifies its restriction with $P^{\oplus[L:E]}$. Componentwise kernels, images and quotients give $H^i(K)^{\oplus[L:E]}$, so both bounds are preserved. Constructible membership follows from [lem-weil-pbc-finite-free-constructible-scalar-transport]; [prop-weil-pbc-integral-tstructure] identifies the integral halves with these ambient bounds.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.11(3); finite-free change of completed coefficient rings and the cohomological bounds

proof.text: By [prop-weil-localized-tstructure] each rational half is the isomorphism closure of its integral image. Since $T_{L/E}Q_E\cong Q_LC_{L/E}$ [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension], step 1 proves rational t-exactness. Apply [lem-per-texact-system-triangle-coherence] to these exact scalar functors: the normalized truncation and cohomology comparisons satisfy the stated tower equations and preserve all three truncation arrows.

source.place: Proposition 1.3.3(i),(ii), Proposition 1.1.9 and Corollary 1.1.10(ii), and 1.3.6: agent extraction of the normalized system-coherence argument of old proof steps 4–5, not a separately numbered theorem in BBD

proof.text: The finite coefficient fields form a small nonempty directed set [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set]. Apply [lem-pod-directed-pair-bounded-tstructure] to the literal pair category [def-weil-pbc-finite-stage-pair-category]. Step 2 verifies t-exactness; the shift and triangles are its stage-image structures [def-weil-pbc-common-stage-cones, thm-weil-pbc-verdier-axioms]. This gives the bounded halves and both representative-independent conjugation formulas, canonical maps, cutoff equations and distinguished truncation triangles.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.14; explicit conjugation and refinement calculation in the pair category

proof.text: Each $j_E$ is exact [thm-weil-pbc-verdier-axioms] and preserves both halves by step 3. Apply [lem-per-texact-system-triangle-coherence] also to $j_E$ and the exact comparisons $j_LT_{L/E}\cong j_E$. Composing the normalized truncations and shift gives naturally $\mathcal H^r(E,K)\cong(E,\mathcal H_E^rK)$ with the same canonical maps.

source.place: Proposition 1.3.3(i),(ii), Proposition 1.1.9 and Corollary 1.1.10(ii), and 1.3.6: agent extraction of the normalized system-coherence argument of old proof steps 4–5, not a separately numbered theorem in BBD

proof.text: Finite diagrams, including inverses and inverse equations, are realized at one stage [prop-weil-pbc-common-stage-calculus]. Apply [lem-per-directed-pair-simultaneous-bounds] to the two half witnesses from step 3: one enlargement puts the scalar extension in both finite halves and identifies it with its degree-zero cohomology object. The converse follows directly from the two half definitions. This proves the asserted heart description.
